Workflows.title: Start a new NGPF Bank Simulator session from the public landing page, verify the dashboard summary is usable, and view the read-only checking account transaction history.
Workflows.goal: The landing page renders with a GET STARTED NOW button; The browser navigates from /bank-sim/home to the simulator dashboard at /bank-sim/; The welcome dialog closes (detaches) and the dashboard remains on screen; The checking account card is visible and shows an AVAILABLE BALANCE label; The browser navigates to the account activity page for the checking account (/bank-sim/account?type=checking); The Account Activity heading is visible; The Checking toggle button carries the active state class; The transactions table is visible with its header row plus at least one data row
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Open the NGPF Bank Simulator landing page — The landing page renders with a GET STARTED NOW button
2. Start a new simulator session by clicking GET STARTED NOW — The browser navigates from /bank-sim/home to the simulator dashboard at /bank-sim/
3. Dismiss the one-time welcome dialog on the dashboard — The welcome dialog closes (detaches) and the dashboard remains on screen
4. Verify the checking account summary card is usable on the dashboard — The checking account card is visible and shows an AVAILABLE BALANCE label
5. Open the checking account activity by clicking VIEW ACCOUNT on the checking card — The browser navigates to the account activity page for the checking account (/bank-sim/account?type=checking)
6. Confirm the account activity page has loaded — The Account Activity heading is visible
7. Confirm the Checking toggle is the active account selection — The Checking toggle button carries the active state class
8. Confirm a read-only transaction history is displayed for the checking account — The transactions table is visible with its header row plus at least one data row
